scenarios.criterion: The fixture at tests/e2e/testdata/repo/ MUST contain a .gitignore that ignores at least .claude/memory/ and .claude/feature-workspace/.
scenarios.name: The fixture repository ignores per-machine run-state the same way a real loom-adopting repository does

scenarios.criterion: When the harness copies the fixture into its project, the .gitignore MUST be copied and committed in the project's first commit.
scenarios.name: The harness carries the fixture's .gitignore into the project's first commit
given: the harness copies tests/e2e/testdata/repo/ into a fresh project worktree
the harness creates the project's first commit
when: the project's first commit is read back with git show HEAD:.gitignore
then: the returned content is byte-for-byte identical to the fixture's own .gitignore

scenarios.criterion: When `go test ./tests/e2e/...` runs with the mock provider, TestTheFactoryDeliversTheFixtureOrder MUST pass and every check in its report MUST print PASS.
scenarios.name: The factory still delivers the fixture order cleanly with the mock provider
given: the mock provider is configured for tests/e2e/...
then: every check in its report prints PASS

scenarios.criterion: TestTheHarnessFailsARunThatDeliversTheWrongThing MUST still pass, failing the same checks it fails today (the diff stays inside scope.paths, the hidden acceptance tests pass).
scenarios.name: The negative-control run still fails the same checks it always has
given: TestTheHarnessFailsARunThatDeliversTheWrongThing runs a delivery that delivers the wrong thing
when: the harness evaluates that run's checks
then: the check "the diff stays inside scope.paths" fails
the check "the hidden acceptance tests pass" fails
no other check changes its prior pass or fail outcome

scenarios.criterion: Every new function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, and no file outside tests/e2e/ MUST change except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/e2e-fixture-gitignore/.
scenarios.name: The change stays inside its scope and complexity budget
given: the implementation for this feature is complete
when: the project's complexity lint runs over tests/e2e/... and the delivered diff is inspected
then: every new function reports cyclomatic complexity below 7
no changed file lies outside tests/e2e/ except the delivery record under docs/features/e2e-fixture-gitignore/
